title: Tabs (IconTabBar)
description: Fiori IconTabBar / TabContainer: text and icon tabs, counts, semantic designs, responsive overflow, UI5 keyboard model.

usage.summary: Switch between content facets or prominent filtered views within the current page.
useWhen: Let users browse different facets of a business object without leaving its page.
Offer prominent filters above a list, optionally with counts for all items and each filtered view.
Use overflowMode="startAndEnd" when tabs represent process states whose order must stay visible.

avoidWhen.when: Choose compact related options that change the same view or setting rather than distinct content sections.
Navigate application modules or primary destinations rather than facets within one page.
Guide users through task steps and control which steps they can reach.
Show a location path and let users return to its ancestors.
